title: Civic-Military Parade Celebrates Independence Day in Brasília
subtitle: The ceremony began shortly after 9 a.m. along the Ministries Esplanade
excerpt: The Independence Day civic-military parade kicked off on the morning of September 7 at the Ministries Esplanade in Brasília.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the morning of September 7, shortly after 9 a.m., the Independence Day civic-military parade got underway along the Ministries Esplanade in central Brasília.

What defines the civic-military parade

The ceremony brings together members of the Armed Forces and civilian agencies to display protocols, uniforms, and flags, marking the celebration of national independence.

Time and location

The starting point was the Ministries Esplanade, the traditional venue for official events in Brasília, with proceedings beginning just after 9 a.m.

With information from Agência Brasil.
